eyebrow: A hardening script, not a one-time checklist
code:
SYSCTL_FILE="/etc/sysctl.d/99-cis-hardening.conf"
if [ ! -f "$SYSCTL_FILE" ]; then
  cat > "$SYSCTL_FILE" <<EOF
net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies = 1
EOF
  sysctl --system
fi
caption: Idempotent: checks current state first, so re-running it changes nothing twice.
